description: A full page stored in the database and shown at /app/fac-pages/<name>.

fields.description: Lower-case letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens, at most 80 characters. Unique among shared pages, and among each user's own pages. It cannot change after the page is saved.
fields.label: Slug

fields.description: Only me: the page opens only for the user who built it. Shared: the page opens for the roles below. Only System Managers can share a page or change a shared one.
fields.label: Visibility

fields.description: Only System Managers see an unpublished shared page. Only System Managers can publish.
fields.label: Published

fields.description: Users with any of these roles can open the page. With no roles, only System Managers can. Listing "All" or "Guest" opens the page to every logged-in user, website users included.
fields.label: Roles

fields.description: The page body. It renders in a shadow root with the mockup kit's classes available.
fields.label: HTML

fields.description: Runs after the HTML renders; root_element is the page's shadow root.
fields.label: Script

name: FAC Page
